description: Master JROM table controller. The single file that lists all table manifests, declares per-table JROM recording policy, and specifies the SQLite database target. sql-tables.py reads this file to discover and create all tables. The always-policy event stream also records completed, phase-gated daemon response runs as replay evidence.

database.note: Path is relative to repo root. Created by sql-tables.py --create.

manifests.description: Canonical KHANARY schema: app tables, ngram tables, intent tables, probability layers
Declared Micronaut identities, program descriptors, and route-contract projections; metadata only
K'UHUL key-grammar extension: ⟁KEY semantic addresses, phase bindings, JROM recording policy, inline schemas for JROM/ELIZA/field-proposal runtime tables

recording_policy.always: Record every mutation event and completed daemon phase-run evidence event to the JROM stream (append_only tables: audit_log, jrom_event)
recording_policy.append_event: Record create/insert events only (user_post, post_reply, media_asset)
recording_policy.evidence_only: Record as evidence candidate; requires Ch'en verification before admission (ngram_*, eliza_trace, field_proposal)
recording_policy.read_only: No JROM recording; table is read-only from JROM perspective (user_profile, session)

authority.note: Table mutations are DATA_ONLY until Ch'en verification and Xul fold closure.
